metadata_policy.stored_content: Minimal identifying metadata and original pedagogical notes only

online_verification.note: Official pages sampled during packaging were used only to verify selected identifiers. Full online revalidation is network-dependent and is reported as Skipped; offline schema, canonical URL form, ownership, access policy, and bank parity are validated for every record.
